E preserves the actual assertion kind, bearer and receiving predicate; a disciplinary label is not a necessary gate. The source artifact may itself be the received endpoint/update/model input. An unrelated policy, merely stored result, different predicate or newly invented auxiliary model is excluded. An already-required and actually used native map is a legitimate bearer for a scoped coverage/model-use ceiling; this does not prove identity, current grant or physical completion. Any received F condition remains an actual hard criterion, not validation evidence or a demand for a richer model.

scientific_record.Cost and simpler: A directly understood authorized action or an adequate incumbent may need no optimizer, new approval body or elaborate preference model.
scientific_record.Residual: This argument does not settle which rights or legal duties apply, establish moral legitimacy, identify an actual decision owner, or prove that a listed action is physically available.
scientific_record.Invalidation: An omitted affected party, newly discovered hard constraint, withdrawn grant, changed objective meaning or unavailable resource can reopen the feasible set and ranking.
